0022600001.text: The Pistons host the Celtics in both teams' 2026-27 opener, as neither side has played a game this season yet. Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is listed as day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 104-103 home win over Boston on January 19, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pistons a 50% chance to win.
